items.body:
Capacity Building Series Building Stronger Associations Three practical steps to help your association get ready for funding, partnerships, and growth. June 2026 The Mosaic Team — Mosaic Multicultural Connections {steps.map((item) = ( {item.step.replace("Step ", "")} {item.title} Ready your association for funding, partnerships, and growth The Mosaic team has been working on a three-step series to help you and your associations get ready. Ready to apply for funding. Ready to partner with others. Ready to grow. This series builds on what we heard from you at the May forum. Each step is practical and designed for where your association is right now. We are here to help you build both. @/app/page-metadata @/components/ui/PageTransition @/components/ui/Section @/components/ui/GlassCard lucide-react /community-leaders-forum/capacity-building-series-june-2026 Capacity Building Series — Building Stronger Associations https://www.mosaicmc.org.au/community-leaders-forum/capacity-building-series-june-2026 Step 1 July Governance Foundations Workshop Funders want to know your association is well run before they invest in your work. Good governance gives them that confidence. Having a clear purpose and a written constitution, so everyone knows what your association stands for and how decisions are made Transparency and accountability, including keeping meeting records, managing finances responsibly, and being open with your members Diverse leadership, making sure women, young people, and different voices from across your community have a place at the table Your responsibilities under NSW Fair Trading and Australian law A well-governed association builds trust with funders and the broader community. Step 2 August Grant Writing Workshop · Leaders Forum Dinner With governance foundations in place, the next step is knowing how to apply for funding. Welcome a sector expert to work through the grant writing process with us Learn how to find the right opportunities for your association Understand what makes a strong and competitive application Save the date: Monday 3rd August 2026. More details to follow. Step 3 September Partner Due Diligence Workshop When your association works with another organisation to deliver a program, apply for funding, or share resources, funders want to know you have done your homework. Protect your association by reducing risks like financial mismanagement and reputational damage Strengthen funding applications with sound partnerships and clear written agreements Build credibility with funders and partners by showing your association is trustworthy and well managed We will keep it simple. Ready your association for funding, partnerships, and growth

The Mosaic team has been working on a three-step series to help you and your associations get ready. Ready to apply for funding. Ready to partner with others. Ready to grow.

This series builds on what we heard from you at the May forum. Each step is practical and designed for where your association is right now.

Happening in June

HMC Community Led Project Design and Grant Writing Workshops

HMC is running grant writing workshops in June with three time slots available, including one online session. You are welcome to join whichever suits you. It is a good chance to get a head start before our August session.

More details on each workshop will be shared closer to the date. Please reach out to the Mosaic team with any questions.

Register

Choose the June session that suits your schedule and get started before the August Leaders Forum Dinner workshop.

Find out more and register

We are walking this journey alongside you. Every step of this series has been designed with your communities in mind. Practical, accessible, and built for where you are right now.
